desc: Derive and verify the edge-separation probabilities for the five cases i=v, i=u, u<i<v, i<u, and i>v.

Implement the O(N+Q) edge-contribution solution: read N,Q and A[2..N] modulo 998244353; precompute inv[1..N+1] linearly, fact=(N-1)!, pref1[i]=sum_{j=2}^i A_j*inv[j], pref2[i]=sum_{j=2}^i A_j*2*(j-1)*inv[j]*inv[j+1]; for each query u<v compute exp = (pref1[v-1]+A[v]) if u==1 else (pref2[u-1]+A[u]*(u-1)*inv[u]+(pref1[v-1]-pref1[u])+A[v]) modulo MOD, then print exp*fact%MOD; run the three samples and small brute-force checks for N<=8 to confirm.
